result.question: Como a taxa de mortalidade por doencas respiratorias compara inverno e fora do inverno por ano?
result.gold_sql: WITH base AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "DT_INTER") IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'inverno' ELSE 'fora_inverno' END AS periodo, "MORTE" FROM internacoes WHERE "DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J%' AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL) SELECT ano, periodo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM base GROUP BY ano, periodo ORDER BY ano, periodo;
